title: Unit 7 Protect the Earth
text: 3 The truck took us to a recycling centre. The workers there put us into different groups. Then I went into a machine.
There I went to sleep. What a long sleep!
4 Hello again! It's me! Now I'm in a library. Yes, I'm a book now! Children like me very much. How wonderful!
What happened to the cardboard box?
